# Stephen Stanhope

## Overview

- **Age:** middle age  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) (child), [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Stephen Stanhope is a tall, well-favored man of middle age. He features iron-gray hair, sunken dark blue eyes, and a powerful, sorrowful countenance that is remarkably shaped around his brow and chin.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)_

## Personality

Stephen Stanhope is a somewhat reserved and proud individual who conceals a deep and tender nature from the public. He is also extremely nervous and easily hurt.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P8](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0008), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)_

## History

Twenty-five years after their original betrothal unexpectedly ended, Stephen Stanhope returned from the United States and had his son's friend deliver a request to visit [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md). After receiving her response, Stephen arrived at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) and reunited with [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) in the garden, where they embraced as lovers. Soon after, he married [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) in a garden ceremony at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) before the newlyweds departed together by train.

_Sources: [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P20](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0020), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P39](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0039), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P45](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0045), +7 more_

**Volume 2**

- betrothed to Rosalind Penrose twenty-five years earlier  <sub>[v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009)</sub>

## Quotes

> "In his final letter, Cedric mentioned traveling alongside you to see a former . . . friend of mine . . . Miss Penrose residing in the stone house located in Welby. Are you well acquainted with her?"
>
> — Stephen Stanhope — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P30](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0030)

> "Yes, it seems to me that you are. Now, I shall request a service from you. Should she permit it, I desire to visit Miss Rosalind. Would you inquire whether she will allow my visit?"
>
> — Stephen Stanhope — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035)

> "Not a single detail of this residence or garden has altered from the time I visited a quarter of a century in the past. It restores my youth."
>
> — Stephen Stanhope — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P60](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0060)

> "Thus, here is the ‘beautiful teacher’ belonging to my small boy, about whom so many things have reached my ears"
>
> — Stephen Stanhope — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P23](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0023)

> "I am curious about the extent of your knowledge"
>
> — Stephen Stanhope — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P33](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0033)

## Relationships

### [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cedric-stanhope--stephen-stanhope.md)

Stephen Stanhope is the father of [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md). During a visit to [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) following the end of the school term, Stephen unexpectedly arrives and interacts with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), asking her to help facilitate a meeting with [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P8](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0008), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), +5 more_

- Parent of  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P8](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0008), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), +1 more</sub>

### [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rosalind-penrose--stephen-stanhope.md)

Stephen Stanhope is the husband of [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), though their past was marked by a presumed former engagement that had ended. After Stephen unexpectedly arrives at his son's residence, he sends a message requesting to see [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md). Upon arriving at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage), the two embrace as lovers in the garden, and they are soon married in a garden ceremony surrounded by friends before departing together by train.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P20](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0020), +12 more_

- presumed Romantically involved with — former engagement that ended  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009)</sub>
